statements.JinWishart.weighted_andreief: (f g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (hfg : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun y => f i y * (w y * g j y)) μ) : (∫ z : Fin n → ℝ, (∏ i, w (z i)) * determinantProduct f g z ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ))) = (n.factorial : ℝ) * (Matrix.of (fun i j => ∫ y, f i y * (w y * g j y) ∂μ)).det
statements.JinWishart.normalizedDeterminantEnsemble: (f g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (w : ℝ → ℝ) (hfg : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun y => f i y * (w y * g j y)) μ) (hpos : ∀ z, 0 ≤ determinantProduct f g z) (hmeas : Measurable (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (determinantProduct f g z))) (hdet : 0 < (determinantMomentMatrix μ f g).det) : (∫ z : Fin n → ℝ, ∏ i, w (z i) ∂(normalizedDeterminantEnsemble μ f g)) = (Matrix.of (fun i j => ∫ y, f i y * (w y * g j y) ∂μ)).det / (determinantMomentMatrix μ f g).det
statements.JinWishart.exp_sum_weighted_andreief: (f g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (hfg : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun y => f i y * (Real.exp (-s*y) * g j y)) μ) : (∫ z : Fin n → ℝ, Real.exp (-s * ∑ i, z i) * determinantProduct f g z ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ))) = (n.factorial : ℝ) * (Matrix.of (fun i j => ∫ y, f i y * (Real.exp (-s*y) * g j y) ∂μ)).det
statements.JinWishart.normalizedDeterminantEnsemble: (f g : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (hfg : ∀ i j, Integrable (fun y => f i y * (Real.exp (-s*y) * g j y)) μ) (hpos : ∀ z, 0 ≤ determinantProduct f g z) (hmeas : Measurable (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (determinantProduct f g z))) (hdet : 0 < (determinantMomentMatrix μ f g).det) : (∫ z : Fin n → ℝ, Real.exp (-s * ∑ i, z i) ∂(normalizedDeterminantEnsemble μ f g)) = (Matrix.of (fun i j => ∫ y, f i y * (Real.exp (-s*y) * g j y) ∂μ)).det / (determinantMomentMatrix μ f g).det
